name: agy-local
description: Local marketplace for the agy-delegate plugin (Google Antigravity CLI delegation for ZCode).

plugins.name: agy-delegate
plugins.description: Delegate coding tasks to Google Antigravity CLI (agy) from ZCode: foreground or background runs, follow-ups in the same agy conversation, cancel, independent change evidence and execution traces. Also runs a local Anthropic-compatible model gateway so agy models can be registered as ZCode custom providers and used by native subagents.
